translations.web: For I am Yahweh your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. Yahweh of Armies is his name.
translations.bsb: For I am the LORD your God who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name.
translations.kjv: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
translations.asv: For I am Jehovah thy God, who stirreth up the sea, so that the waves thereof roar: Jehovah of hosts is his name.
